description.value: Johnny's Motel is an award-winning, family-run budget motel set on the banks of the Granby River at the crossing of two rivers in Grand Forks, BC — a location the property calls the best in the city. Rooms open directly onto the riverbank and the motel sits just minutes from downtown shops and restaurants, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists on the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) corridor. Grand Forks is noted on the website as a base for cycling the Kettle Valley Trail.

address.value: 7291 Hwy 3 E., Grand Forks, BC V0H 1H0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Johnny's Motel is a real, operating family-run budget motel in Grand Forks, BC, on the banks of the Granby River. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated in multiple places on the site and corroborated by the OSM internet_access=wlan tag; the site also explicitly places the motel within a few minutes' walk of downtown restaurants. No bike-specific storage, tools, laundry, or e-bike charging are mentioned anywhere on the site. The website content appears dated (rate tables reference 2016–2017 seasons and 2014/2015 award years), but there is no indication the business is closed.
concerns: Website content appears significantly outdated: rate tables reference the 2016–2017 season and 'Budget Motel Winner' awards are from 2014 and 2015. The site may not reflect current offerings or contact details.

OSM address field ('7291 Crowsnest Highway') omits city and postal code; website provides the more complete form used here ('7291 Hwy 3 E., Grand Forks, BC V0H 1H0'). Hwy 3 and Crowsnest Highway are the same road — no factual conflict.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational motel on a major cycling corridor (Hwy 3 / Crowsnest Highway) with confirmed Wi-Fi and proximity to downtown amenities — a straightforward inclusion for touring cyclists.
